demo.title: breakra.sh
demo.code:
# Free and local, no wallet: does this OpenAPI change break callers?
git clone --branch v0.2.0 --depth 1 https://github.com/danbuildss/breakra && cd breakra && bun install
bun src/cli.ts check old.yaml new.yaml

# Hosted: $0.02 USDC on Base via x402, only with the user's authorization.
# The client checks the terms (exact, Base USDC, <= $0.02, amount 20000) and signs once; Breakra's own errors are never charged.
BREAKRA_KEY_FILE=./wallet.key bun examples/client.ts old.json new.json

setup: No signup or API key: payment via x402 is the authorization ($0.02 USDC per analysis on Base)
Only a 200 is charged; Breakra's own errors (invalid input, oversize specs) are never charged
Send two inline OpenAPI 3.0 JSON documents, before and after, up to 1 MB in total
Pay once per call: check the 402 terms (exact, eip155:8453, USDC, amount 20000) and never re-sign automatically
